title: Federated learning for media content recommendation

pse.problem: Inefficient media content recommendation in applications due to lack of real-time user interaction data
pse.solution_function: Federated learning for media content recommendation where a machine learning model updates itself based on user interactions with recommended media content at client devices, improving the accuracy of recommended media content
pse.solution_structure: A server that provides and receives updates to a machine learning model, and client devices equipped with processors and memory units
pse.solution_implementation: The server initially provides a version of the machine learning model to client devices. The client devices recommend media content based on local information using the provided model. User interactions with recommended media content are used to determine updates to the model, which are then sent back to the server. The server updates the model based on received updates from multiple client devices
pse.effect: Improved accuracy in recommending media content that users are interested in, leading to increased user satisfaction and potential for increased application engagement
